summary: Wisconsin Electric Power Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for a debt offering of 5.10% debentures due 2036, an additional tranche to its existing series. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Terms are incomplete in the preliminary document. The debentures are unsecured, unlisted, and subject to optional redemption, with a tax credit event redemption at 101%. There is no board recommendation, M&A mechanics, or deal structure. The filing is an ordinary debt issuance for financing purposes. No special-situation angle applies; the appropriate classification is 'None'.
